args: Confirm the ownership semantics in the named-color branch of `_cmsReadDevicelinkLUT` at `lcms/src/cmsio1.c` lines 720-742: does `cmsReadTag(hProfile, cmsSigNamedColor2Tag)` return a profile-owned cached `cmsNAMEDCOLORLIST`, and does `_cmsStageAllocNamedColor(nc, FALSE)` duplicate that list so that `cmsPipelineFree(Lut)` owns/frees only its duplicate? Is removing `cmsFreeNamedColorList(nc)` from the Error path the complete root-cause fix, including when pipeline allocation or stage insertion fails?

The supplied ASan report shows `_cmsReadDevicelinkLUT` freeing `nc` at cmsio1.c:741 after a malformed named-color pipeline fails construction, followed by `cmsCloseProfile` calling `Type_NamedColor_Free` on the same cached tag and reporting heap-use-after-free. I inspected lines 705-802: `nc` comes directly from `cmsReadTag`; `Lut` is allocated separately; the named-color stage is inserted via `_cmsStageAllocNamedColor(nc, FALSE)`; all failures jump to an Error label that calls `cmsPipelineFree(Lut)` and then explicitly frees `nc`. Other LUT paths in this function explicitly comment that cmsReadTag results are profile-owned and duplicate them. The proposed minimal patch is to retain `cmsPipelineFree(Lut)` but remove the explicit free of `nc`, because profile closure remains responsible for the cached tag.
